one_line: Sales pipeline CRM with a RESTful API (v1 and v2) covering deals, leads, activities, projects, and reporting.
auth_notes: API token can be obtained manually from the Pipedrive app settings; OAuth2 for marketplace apps. OpenAPI 3 spec available for import into Postman/Insomnia; official Node.js and PHP client libraries. Stateless JSON API, CORS-capable.
self_serve_notes: Free trial then paid plans; API token available from any account. Free sandbox account can be requested from the Developer Sandbox page for testing.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: ~30+ resource areas (deals, leads, persons, organizations, activities, projects, goals, billing, webhooks)
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks endpoint documented for real-time event notifications

existing_mcp.note: No official Pipedrive MCP server found; several community servers exist on GitHub/MCP registry

evidence.note: Fetched text was detailed API reference confirming REST, API token, OAuth2, webhooks, sandbox account

agent_notes: No official MCP found; verdict otherwise straightforward. API requires a paid/trial account for ongoing access.
